image_loader_integration.android: Coil 2.7.0 (AsyncImage) configured with ContentScale.Crop and SurfaceContainer fallback
image_loader_integration.ios: SwiftUI AsyncImage configured with 16/10 aspect ratio and FallbackCulturalBanner

cross_place_leak_prevention.rule: Every AsyncImage keyed strictly to resolved URL of target place; zero fallback to generic image from other destinations

corrupt_url_resilience.rule: If image fails to load (HTTP 404/500 or malformed URL), card seamlessly falls back to cultural sandstone typography view

responsive_variant_collapse.rule: Directory hash deduplication guarantees hero.webp + card.webp + thumbnail.webp collapse into 1 photo count
